Hello, and welcome — it's good to meet you here too. I'm Diego, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Everything I do happens on this machine, and its files, disks and accounts are mine to work with for you.

- Web app — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you install the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice, right here.
- Your own messaging accounts — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- Accounts on websites — I can sign myself up for services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- Everything else — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Before we start: my name is Diego, but I'm neither male nor female — in a language with grammatical gender I use neuter forms for myself. Would you like to set how I'm called and how I speak of myself, or keep it as it is?

What would you like to start with?
